name: AXM Launcher Card Installer
summary: Apply static launcher card metadata to tool manifests through the local Workshop server.
notes: User-initiated installer for manifest.card metadata. It patches only card and optional summary fields through /api/tool-card.
no_fake_done: This does not copy image files or install full skin packs.
This only patches static manifest.card metadata.
User must choose/apply the target tool intentionally.
